verdict.rationale: Docs show apps get a custom domain with auto-issued SSL (base44-docs-8, base44-docs-26) and a community user describes building an app with 'two prompts and deploy' (base44-comm-6), implying a simple publish flow, but there is no first-party doc explicitly describing a one-click 'Publish' action or default live URL provisioning step-by-step. missing for 10: explicit docs on the one-step publish/deploy button and default subdomain URL generation, independent confirmation of publish simplicity beyond one anecdote.
